QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Watchman Bavan's Request
QuestInfo.0: #b#m310000000##k's watchman, #b#p2152016##k, is grumbling and looking for someone.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152016# the watchman says his job is to take the #t4000598#s out of #o1150000#s, but he wants you to do it, because he's feeling lazy. Defeat #r#o1150000#s#k and find #b20#k #b#t4000598#s#k, then take them over to #b#p2152017##k the watchman, who is in charge of tape analysis.\n\n#i4000598# #t4000598# #b#c4000598# / 20#k
QuestInfo.2: Watchman #p2152017#, as with #p2152016#, seemed annoyed when she received the #t4000598#.

0.0: Hey, you! What was your name again? Ah, never mind! That's not important! You seem bored, so do me a favor. You wouldn't refuse the request of #p2152016#, the Black Wing Watchman in charge of this town, now would you?

yes.0: Of course you'll help me. Now go retrieve #b20 #t4000598#s#k from the #r#o1150000#s#k and deliver them to #b#p2152017##k. And yes, that's supposed to be my job, but so what? I'm just too busy to handle trivial things like that.

no.0: Refuse?! The merciful #p2152016# will give you one more chance so think carefully.

1.0: What do you want? I'm busy. Go talk to #p2152016# if you have a question! Hey, these are the\r\n#t4000598# items I needed. Geez, I told #p2152016# to stop making others do his job. Hand them over.

yes.0: This is quite a lot. Ahh, I wish I could give my job to someone else like #p2152016# does. I can't just make someone else do the analysis work, though. Huh? Are you still here? You can go now.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #b#p2152017##k yet? You just need to get #b20 #t4000598#s#k from the #k#r#o1150000#s#k and deliver them to #p2152017#. It's a really annoying job. I'm so glad there are people like you who can do it for me. Hehe.

item.0: When is #b#p2152016##k planning on bringing me the #b#t4000598#s#k. Is he going to make someone else do it again?
